record_type_quote:
Our conceptual replication study aimed to understand the generalizability of the original findings from
Peterson
et al.
(2019)
—that the introduction of a simple antibias statement to SETs can mitigate bias toward instructor gender within the context of a biology department.

targets.authors: Peterson, D. A. M., Biederman, L. A., Andersen, D., Ditonto, T. M., & Roe, K.
targets.title: Mitigating gender bias in student evaluations of teaching.
targets.evidence_quote:
Our conceptual replication study aimed to understand the generalizability of the original findings from
Peterson
et al.
(2019)
—that the introduction of a simple antibias statement to SETs can mitigate bias toward instructor gender within the context of a biology department.
targets.outcome_quote:
Unlike
Peterson
et al.
(2019)
, our findings at the departmental level do not support that the simple inclusion of an Antibias statement mitigates the complex issue of gender biases toward instructors in SETs.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The explicit overall departmental verdict does not support mitigation; it governs over individual semesters that agreed.

reasoning: Conceptual replication with new student evaluation data; other replications are context rather than targets.
